verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents the Relay Proxy, a Go application that runs on your own infrastructure and proxies the LaunchDarkly streaming connection to clients within your organization's network. Independent community engineers corroborate running the open-source Relay for extra resiliency and closer to services. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of continued flag serving during a vendor outage (e.g., persistent-store/offline mode details), and detail on configuring SDKs to route all traffic solely through the relay.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network

citations.quote: The LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy is a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure.
It connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients within your organization’s network.
LaunchDarkly has an open source 'Relay' you can run in your own environment for extra resiliency.
LD's open-source Relay lets you run proxies closer to your services.
